records.notes: Full continuous reading 1–560 and561–1117. File/section diagnostics truncate display only; whole PBS readers handle BOM/preprocessing and repeated/ordinary schema keys. Current get_csv_record uses split_csv_line and case-dependent optional casts; positive integer v rejects0, unsignedu permits0. Deprecated scanner differs and is not substituted. Species parsing uppercases with Nidoran exceptions. PBS discovery is top-level *.txt, base/prefix matching, hence Gen backup subdirectories are alternative materials, not simultaneous default input. Compile dependency order loads species/forms before encounter; main may delete archive files before compile and again on exceptions. No compiler executed.

Full continuous1–450/451–900/901–1321. Generic parser clears registry before records and validates then registers; final save occurs after all. Species validators convert stats/EV and tenths weight/height; first-found reverse ancestry with form-key preference, None forward links. Forms selectively inherit scalar/list/move/evolution/wild-item properties; no blanket identity alias. Encounter compile accepts integer-prefix map/version/probability, positive slot weights and levels, range validation, same species/level slot merge and weight-desc/id-asc sort. New map registers previous map before duplicate detection; repeated type resets slots but uses prior/default probability. Phone ids parsed by generic section converter. Read unrelated trainer/facility/metadata/animation definitions too; these require separate primary owners, not omitted.

Full continuous1–420/421–821. Generic writers choose suffix files and overwrite directly; species base/form writers separate enumerations and property suppression, no lossless/atomic guarantee. Encounter writer omits empty types and emits probability only if>0, yielding zero→omitted→type-default on next compile; current snapshot not refreshed by writer. Default registration/disk/output/runtime layers remain separate. Full trainer/facility/metadata/dungeon/phone and write_all branches read; no writer invoked.

Read full455 lines. Complete schema, editor metadata, constructor defaults, species/form query, localization, form flags, stats, all evolution-family/baby/egg-move helpers and PBS projection. HatchSteps schema v vs constructor1 vs editor99999 are separate. Family recursion sorts by definition keys; None links allowed when requested. Baby recursion uses selected prevolution and parent incense items; breeding_can_produce tests offspring/family intersection. Shared egg-list helper recurses prevolution with same form while generator reads raw list. PBS projection can mutate nested evolution records; linked kernel/Creature-A primary handling retained.

Read full246 lines. Full graphic fallback combinations, egg/cracks/icon/footprint/shadow selection and Pokemon consumers; egg-specific lookup vs fallback000 distinct. Ordinary sprite path reads dynamic form and derived caches; bitmap alteration copies/disposes before custom effect. Cry lookup form-specific fallback and suffix behavior, egg suppression, pitch divisor and rescue boundaries. No actual resources or host effects observed.

Creation handlers UNOWN/PUMPKABOO/SINISTEA/etc; same-value direct form setter may invoke move-changing callbacks e.g ROTOM/KYUREM/NECROZMA/CALYREX. Dynamic season DEERLING→SAWSBUCK, timed FURFROU/HOOPA, ability/item-dependent forms and all start/enter/leave battle actions read.
